description: MS Access is a popular Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) developed by Microsoft. It is primarily used to efficiently organize, manage, and analyze large amounts of relational data.

sections.title: Basic Terminology
sections.description: Essential terms required to understand a database and its fundamental components.

key_concepts.explanation: An electronic and organized collection of related data that can be easily accessed, managed, and updated.
The most important and primary database object used to store data in a structured format of rows and columns.
Relational Database Management System is a software system that stores data in multiple related tables, allowing them to be linked together.

sections.title: Key Elements of a Table
sections.description: The main structural components that define the internal architecture of a table in MS Access.

key_concepts.explanation: A vertical column in a table that represents a specific category or attribute of data, such as 'Employee Name' or 'Salary'.
A horizontal row in a table that contains a complete set of related information about a single person, product, or entity.
A specific field (or combination of fields) that uniquely identifies each record in a table. It strictly cannot contain duplicate values or null (empty) values.
A field in one table that is directly linked to the Primary Key of another table, establishing a logical relationship between the two.

sections.title: Database Objects
sections.description: The four primary functional objects used to interact with and manage data in MS Access.

key_concepts.explanation: A structured request or instruction made to find, extract, or filter specific data from the database based on certain conditions.
A Graphical User Interface (GUI) object designed to allow users to easily enter, edit, or view data in the tables.
An output object specifically designed to summarize, format, calculate, and print data either on a screen or a physical paper.
A set of saved actions or instructions used to automate repetitive tasks and add functionality to forms and reports.

sections.title: File Extensions and Data Types
sections.description: Crucial file formats associated with MS Access and the specific types of data it can support.

sections.title: MS Access Keyboard Shortcuts
sections.description: Highly useful shortcut keys to enhance productivity and navigation within MS Access.

sections.title: Important Exam Facts
sections.description: Crucial one-liner facts related to MS Access that are frequently asked in competitive exams.

important_facts.fact: MS Access operates fundamentally on the 'Microsoft Jet Database Engine'.
Structured Query Language (SQL) is the underlying standard language used in MS Access to communicate with and manipulate the database backend.
'Referential Integrity' rules are strictly enforced in MS Access to ensure data accuracy, prevent orphaned records, and maintain consistency between related tables.
